instruction: I have four images named pic1.png through pic4.png located on the Desktop. Please create a new presentation containing exactly four blank slides (no text boxes or other elements), then insert the images in sequential order—pic1.png on slide 1, pic2.png on slide 2, pic3.png on slide 3, and pic4.png on slide 4. This presentation will be used for an automated slideshow display.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 4 blank slides and inserting pic1.png through pic4.png sequentially (one image per slide). Expected: 4 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. Verified by checking the Gold file shows each slide has 1 image shape.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical: Cannot verify 'blank slides' requirement - instruction explicitly requires slides with no text boxes or other elements, but evaluator only counts images and does not check for absence of other shapes (text boxes, titles, etc.)

Significant: Cannot verify sequential image order - instruction requires pic1.png on slide 1, pic2.png on slide 2, etc., but evaluator only checks that each slide has 1 image without verifying which specific image is on which slide
Partial credit: Correctly verifies slide count (4 slides) and image count per slide (1 image each)
Getter logic is correct for what it checks, but incomplete coverage of instruction requirements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add logic to getter to count ALL shapes per slide (not just images) and verify that each slide has exactly 1 shape (the image), ensuring no text boxes or other elements exist
Add logic to getter to extract image metadata (filename or image hash) to verify correct image sequencing - check that slide 1 contains pic1.png, slide 2 contains pic2.png, etc.
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require '4 slides with 1 image each' without the blank slides and sequential ordering requirements, if those cannot be verified
